courses.overview: 由儲存攜帶轉送、接觸計畫與資料壽命連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect store-carry-forward, contact plans and data lifetime to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 低軌衛星網路路由
related.why: 可移植「DTN 覆疊層」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from dtn overlay; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.transfer: 可移植「DTN 覆疊層」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from dtn overlay; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理儲存攜帶轉送、接觸計畫與資料壽命；「低軌衛星網路路由」主要處理時變拓撲、交遞與星間路由，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes store-carry-forward, contact plans and data lifetime; Low-Earth-orbit satellite-network routing emphasizes time-varying topology, handover and intersatellite routing. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「深空延遲容忍網路」與「低軌衛星網路路由」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「持久儲存」的對照方法至「接觸預測」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Deep-space delay-tolerant networking and Low-Earth-orbit satellite-network routing flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from persistent storage to contact prediction, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

related.title: 量子通訊網路測試平台
related.why: 可移植「DTN 覆疊層」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。

related.transfer: 可移植「DTN 覆疊層」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from dtn overlay; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理儲存攜帶轉送、接觸計畫與資料壽命；「量子通訊網路測試平台」主要處理量子光鏈路、糾纏與古典控制平面，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes store-carry-forward, contact plans and data lifetime; Quantum-communication network testbeds emphasizes quantum optical links, entanglement and classical control planes. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「深空延遲容忍網路」與「量子通訊網路測試平台」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「持久儲存」的對照方法至「Coincidence」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Deep-space delay-tolerant networking and Quantum-communication network testbeds flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from persistent storage to coincidence measurements, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.
